fuel.dashboardHint: Fuel and charging are shown separately for each vehicle. Consumption uses full-to-full intervals when available; estimates are labeled and fuel and electricity are never combined.
fuel.noVehiclesHint: Add a vehicle first, then record fuel or charging in its details.
fuel.vehicleHint: Record fuel and charging separately for this vehicle. Enter the odometer total; for hybrids, record fuel and electricity independently.
fuel.separateEnergyHint: Fuel and electricity are calculated separately and should not be added together. Full records define intervals; values based on incomplete boundaries are labeled estimates.
fuel.hybridHint: Fuel and electricity remain separate for hybrids. Since both use the same odometer distance, their individual propulsion distance cannot be separated reliably, so L/100km and kWh/100km are hidden. Spending trends are also separated by energy type.
fuel.fullTank: Filled the tank (used for accurate interval consumption)
fuel.formHint: Amount paid is used for cost stats. If omitted, quantity × unit price is estimated. You can save without a cost and add it later.
fuel.invalidRecord: Enter a valid date, odometer, and liters or kWh. Amounts and unit prices must be non-negative; cost can be added later.
fuel.odometerWarning: Odometer readings did not increase in this record stream. Check the date, reading, or a reset; the invalid interval was skipped.
fuel.boundaryWarning: Records before the first full point are excluded. Records after the latest full point remain open and are not counted until the next full tank/charge.
fuel.monthlyCostHint: Monthly totals sum individual records. They use a different basis from the measurable interval distance above; records without an amount are excluded.
fuel.baselineHint: Records are saved. Mark a real full tank/charge as a baseline; the next full record completes the first measurable interval.
fuel.emptyHint: No records yet. Enter the odometer total and mark full tank/charge when applicable.
fuel.noRecords: No records yet. Use the button above to add one.
fuel.deleteEntryConfirm: This permanently deletes the fuel/charging record and recalculates stats. Delete it?
fuel.estimatedNotice: Current values are estimated from adjacent records. Full-to-full stats take priority once two full records are entered.

ledger.ocrHint: Image OCR runs only when requested. Results are saved to SiYuan OCR text and included in search. Images in encrypted notebooks are not supported.
ledger.ocrSetupIntro: Lv Home uses the OCR settings on this SiYuan device. It does not install or switch engines. Older SiYuan versions may not include OCR settings or APIs. Manual recognition does not require automatic OCR to be enabled.
ledger.ocrSetupStep1: Confirm your SiYuan version includes OCR. If OCR is missing from Settings, update SiYuan.
ledger.ocrSetupStep2: Open Settings → OCR and configure an available local engine or an AI model you have already set up. If a local engine is unavailable, follow the OCR page's setup guidance.
ledger.ocrSetupStep3: Return to this attachment and click View / recognize text.
ledger.ocrSetupStorage: Results are saved to SiYuan OCR text and included in search. Images in encrypted notebooks are not supported.
ledger.ocrSetupAI: With the AI engine selected, the image is sent to your configured AI service. The plugin asks for confirmation before each run.
ledger.ocrResultStored: The result is saved to SiYuan OCR text and included in search. Recognizing again replaces this image's previous OCR text. Check it against the image; Lv Home will not fill certificate or ledger fields from it.
ledger.ocrCopyFailed: Could not copy. Select the text and copy it manually.
ledger.ocrConfigFailed: Could not read OCR settings or result: ${msg}
ledger.ocrAIConfirmTitle: Send this image to AI for recognition?
ledger.ocrAIConfirmBody: This image will be sent to your configured AI service “${provider} / ${model}” for text recognition; service charges may apply. The result is saved to SiYuan OCR text and included in search, replacing any previous result. Confirm only if this image may be sent to that service.
